name: Lethal ape Reworked
summary:
Lethal Ape Reworked is a fast-paced survival horror VR experience where you step into the role of a primate trapped inside a dark, abandoned facility. Using immersive gorilla-style movement, you must swing, climb, and navigate through pitch-black corridors and experimental zones while being hunted by a relentless, unknown creature.

Every sound matters. Every movement could give away your position. Whether you play solo or with friends, the goal is simple: survive the depths of the facility and escape befor
